pricingPolicy: Highest published fixed price used where staff-level prices exist.
durationPolicy: Temporary booking policy: all services use a 60-minute estimated duration and online booking is enabled until verified service-specific durations are available.

services.name: Short Cuts (above earlobe)
services.description: Precision short haircut for hair above the earlobe, shaped to suit your face, hair texture and personal style. A professional short hair cutting and styling service with a polished salon finish.

services.name: Child Cuts
services.description: Gentle children's haircut for under 3s, adapted to hair length, thickness and comfort. A professional children's hair cutting service designed for a neat, manageable finish.

services.name: Blow-dry
services.description: Professional salon blow-dry with smooth, polished styling tailored to your hair type. Ideal for everyday styling, events or a fresh post-treatment finish.

services.name: Natural Curly Cuts & Diffuse
services.description: Specialist haircut for naturally curly and textured hair, finished with diffusing to enhance curl shape, definition and movement. Blowout styling is booked separately.

services.name: Natural Curly Wash & Diffused
services.description: Curly hair wash and diffuse service designed to refresh natural curls, support definition and create a soft, controlled finish without unnecessary heat styling.

services.name: Flat Iron Tong
services.description: Flat iron or tong styling for sleek straight hair, soft waves or defined curls. A professional heat-styling service for a polished salon finish.

services.name: Hair up
services.description: Professional hair-up and occasion styling for events, parties, weddings and special occasions. Final style and price are confirmed during consultation.

services.name: Curly Perm
services.description: Professional curly perm service for clients seeking longer-lasting curl, wave and texture. Hair condition, desired result and price are assessed during consultation.

services.name: Full Head Weave
services.description: Full-head weave installation for added length, volume and styling versatility. Hair type, method, desired finish and price are confirmed during consultation.

services.name: Weave Tracks
services.description: Weave track installation for targeted length, volume or styling support, priced per track. Consultation confirms placement, quantity and suitability for your hair.

services.name: Twist/Cornrows
services.description: Protective twist and cornrow styling tailored to your hair type, pattern and desired look. Style complexity, preparation requirements and price are confirmed during consultation.

services.name: Stocking Caps
services.description: Stocking-cap weave preparation and styling service for a secure foundation and customised finish. Suitability, hair requirements and price are confirmed during consultation.

services.name: T-Section
services.description: T-section highlights and colour placement to brighten the hairline, parting and visible top sections with targeted dimension. Hair finish is booked separately.

services.name: Half Head
services.description: Half-head highlights or colour placement to add brightness, contrast and dimension through selected sections of the hair. Hair finish is booked separately.

services.name: Full Head High-lights
services.description: Full-head highlights for multi-dimensional colour, brightness and an even highlighted finish throughout the hair. Hair finish is booked separately.

services.name: Root Colour
services.description: Professional root colour application to refresh regrowth, maintain colour continuity and blend new growth with existing hair colour. Hair finish is booked separately.

services.name: Virgin App Colour
services.description: Full virgin hair colour application for hair that has not previously been coloured, creating an even all-over colour result. Hair finish is booked separately.

services.name: Creative Colour/Balayage
services.description: Creative hair colour and balayage service for customised, dimensional colour, soft blends and personalised placement. Additional toner may be required depending on the target result.

services.name: Semi-Permanent/Gloss
services.description: Semi-permanent hair colour or gloss service to refresh tone, enhance shine and add temporary colour with lower commitment. Pricing starts from the listed amount and varies by hair needs.

services.name: Toner
services.description: Professional hair toner service to refine unwanted tones, refresh colour and customise the final shade after lightening or colouring. Pricing varies according to hair length and colour requirements.

services.name: Colour Correction
services.description: Specialist hair colour correction for uneven, unwanted or complex previous colour results. A consultation is required to assess hair history, condition, realistic outcomes and pricing.

services.name: Virgin Relaxer
services.description: Virgin hair relaxer service for previously unrelaxed hair, designed to reduce curl and create a straighter, more manageable finish. Suitability depends on hair condition and history.

services.name: Root Relax
services.description: Root relaxer retouch for new growth, helping maintain a straighter finish while avoiding unnecessary overlap on previously relaxed lengths.

services.name: Hair Line
services.description: Targeted hairline relaxer service for smoothing and managing regrowth around the perimeter and visible hairline while limiting treatment to the required area.

services.name: Virgin App X-Tenso Cold
services.description: L'Oréal X-Tenso cold straightening service for a virgin application, designed to reduce curl and create a smoother, straighter finish. Suitability depends on hair condition and history.

services.name: Virgin App X-Tenso Hot
services.description: L'Oréal X-Tenso hot or super-straightening service for a virgin application. Hair condition, previous chemical services, desired result and price are assessed during consultation.

services.name: Roots X-Tenso
services.description: X-Tenso root straightening retouch for new growth, helping maintain a smoother, straighter finish while focusing treatment on the regrowth area.

services.name: Olaplex
services.description: Olaplex bond-building hair treatment designed to support hair strength and integrity, especially for coloured, lightened, chemically treated or stressed hair.

services.name: Scalp Care
services.description: Professional scalp care treatment designed to cleanse, refresh and condition the scalp while supporting a healthier-feeling environment for hair and scalp.

services.name: Custom Blend
services.description: Custom-blended hair treatment selected around your hair's condition, texture and moisture needs for a personalised salon conditioning service.

services.name: Intense Moisture
services.description: Intensive moisture hair treatment for dry, dehydrated or stressed hair, designed to improve softness, manageability and hydration.

services.name: Moroccan Oil
services.description: Moroccan oil conditioning treatment for lightweight hydration, softness and improved manageability, suitable for hair needing moisture without a heavy finish.

services.name: Power Dose
services.description: Express professional hair conditioning treatment for a quick boost of hydration and manageability when you want targeted care with minimal appointment time.
